ratings_why.fun: The now-or-later economy puzzle is good to draft, but turns 2-4 are thin and most growth is flat +1/+1 per arrival, capped by a 4-card hand.
ratings_why.distinct: Buying into a delayed Hold, a tier-above Back Channel and fielding the Hold in the fight play unlike any of today's tribes.

verdict_why: Nan Silverholt and Reed-island Fence need one rules line to close a copy loop; the rest could settle.

points.text: Nan Silverholt's copy reaches the hand without being bought, so Reed-island Fence sends it to the Hold, where it comes Ashore and is copied again every turn; with Pebble Jack the Hold doubles each turn. Say Nan's copies go straight to hand and skip Fence.
Early fights rest on Mudslide Pup alone, and a turn-2 Run fields nothing until turn 3. A Tier 2 body that fights well on the turn something arrives would make the opening feel like part of the plan.
Creel Hauler and Officer Nyx are the only fight hooks and they are the tribe's best feel. A Tier 4 card that lets one Hold unit fight would bring the hidden-fleet line online before Tier 5.
Old Jasmine is a plain game-long counter. A capstone that pays off the Hold or the Back Channel directly would end the climb on the tribe's own idea.
Runner builds and quiet-turn builds pull against each other, which is a good choice; Grisel at the end of a quiet build is a clear goal worth reaching.

standouts.why: Lantern Reach Lookout's Back Channel delivers the seed: a tier-above unit you can only smuggle.
Officer Nyx turns the Hold into a hidden bench your opponent never sees on your last board.
Reed-island Fence makes Discovers, triples and Birds' returns into arrivals, a strong cross-tribe hook.

weakest.why: Reedwhistle is a generic per-arrival buffer with nothing of its own.
Pipe Stoker is a familiar sell trigger; it works but adds no new play.
Old Jasmine is a counter capstone that ignores the Hold.

flags.note: Whether Nan Silverholt's copy goes through Reed-island Fence into the Hold is not stated, and if it does it loops every turn.
Creel Hauler scales with Hold size, and Nan plus Fence plus Pebble Jack can grow the Hold without limit.
Grisel can Seize the Back Channel each quiet turn, a free Tier 6 unit after a big uncapped-gold Refresh dig.
Pebble Jack doubles Nan Silverholt's copies; with Fence that becomes exponential.
